Editor's note—
Ord. No. 4733, § 1, adopted June 15, 2020, repealed Ch. 90. X., §§ 90-1—90-3, 90-31—90-34,
               and 90-61—90-65, and enacted a new Ch. 90 as set out herein. The former Ch. 90 pertained
               to similar subject matter and derived from 1960 Code, § 11-11, 11-13, 11-14; 1981
               Code, §§ 29-1—29-3, 29-16, 29-17, 29-19; Ord. No. 1680, §§ 1-3, adopted Aug. 4, 1980;
               Ord. 1909, § 2, adopted Feb. 21, 1983; and Ord. No. 4097, § 2, adopted Nov. 19, 2007.
